name: Thai Red Curry Lentil Stew with Sweet Potato, Green Beans & Yogurt
ingredients: ¼ cup Thai curry paste, red
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes.
Place water, coconut milk, and curry paste in a large pot. Stir to combine the broth and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the broth is simmering, add sweet potato and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the green beans.
Drain and rinse lentils; add to the bowl with the veggies.
When the sweet potato is tender, add veggies, lentils, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine the stew and return to a simmer.
Once simmering, cover the stew with a lid and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Divide stew between bowls and top with yogurt. Serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
